prompts.name: booboo
prompts.prompt: Production transparent animation keyframe sheet. Exactly 5 columns x 5 rows, 25 complete separated subjects. NO text, numbers, borders, floor, props, scenery or other animals. Reference sheet is identity reference ONLY: use the exact same character, fur/scales, colors, eyes, limbs, ears/horns, proportions and rendering style. One complete animal per cell, generous 12% empty margins so tail/wings/ears/paws/effects NEVER crop or cross cells. Equal body scale and floor baseline throughout. Soft fixed lighting. Small smooth continuous adjacent pose changes; no exaggerated expression, no frequent head tilts. Each row is five consecutive keyframes of one activity, read left to right. First and last poses specified must match natural idle/sleep/profile poses from reference. Actual alpha transparency including gaps. Full artwork detail. White Holland lop BooBoo: fluffy cream-white fur, peach-pink droopy long ears, glossy dark eyes, tiny pink nose. ROW1 wake_stretch: lying down awake sleepy, push chest up, extend rear legs in gentle waking stretch, bring legs underbody, upright front-facing sitting idle. ROW2 wash_face: front sitting, raise BOTH front paws near muzzle, rub cheeks and face with paws (single face, correct paw anatomy), lower paws, return front idle. ROW3 sniff: front idle, tiny nose twitch/chest sniff, lean nose forward slightly, subtle nose wiggle, return same front idle. ROW4 hind_stretch: front sitting, rise into diagonal profile, extend hind legs backward while front paws planted, gather hind legs, return front idle. ROW5 travel_ready: front sitting idle, rotate body gently 25degrees right,45degrees right,side-facing right rise onto paws, right-facing normal walking start stance. Both drooping ears stay anatomically consistent, far ear naturally occluded in profile, no duplicated ears.
